title: Ovenless Thai Rice Flatbread
description: Yeasty, flaky flatbread with Chinese five spice, perfect for post-workout meals.
instructions: In a bowl, combine rice flour, salt, and Chinese five spice powder.
In a separate bowl, dissolve yeast and sugar in warm water and let sit for 5 minutes until frothy.
Pour the yeast mixture into the dry ingredients and stir until a shaggy dough forms.
Add coconut oil to the dough and knead by hand for 5 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Cover the dough with a damp cloth and let rise at room temperature for 45 minutes until doubled in size.
Punch down the dough and divide it into 4 equal portions.
Roll each portion into a thin circle about 8 inches in diameter.
Heat a non-stick tava or griddle over medium heat and lightly spray with oil.
Place a flatbread on the hot surface and cook for 2 minutes on each side until golden brown and flaky.
Sprinkle fresh lime zest over the cooked flatbread and serve warm.
